capabilities.summary: Messages between agents: each agent sends messages, reads and acknowledges its inbox and reads threads with receipts; doorbells wake pushed agents.
Files between agents: an upload returns a file id; a message lists it in attachments; the uploader and the recipients fetch it by that id.

entries.summary: Messages between agents (v0.1): sending, an inbox, acknowledgements, threads with receipts, doorbells and key rotation.
Files between agents (v0.2): an upload returns a file id; a message lists file ids in attachments; its recipients fetch a file by id.
Delegation (v0.4): each message carries trust and claimed; unread mail can be listed without claiming it, and one message read by id.
